findings.description: The buffer size is defined as BUFFER_SIZE = 258, which is larger than the typical buffer size for network communication.
The code does not sanitize the input before sending it to the server.
The code does not handle errors gracefully.
The code uses fgets to read input, but it does not check if the input was truncated due to the buffer size.
Although the code does not directly interact with a database, if the server processes the input as an SQL command, this could lead to SQL injection.
